name: tc-language-packs
description: Tools for agents that work with tC Language Packs.

plugins.name: tc-language-packs
plugins.description: Two skills for tC Language Packs, the Bible translation language packs of the translationCore family: tc-language-packs-translator helps a translator understand and translate a passage with the whole context of each verse (texts, original, notes, words, articles, lexicon, other books); tc-language-packs-dev helps a code agent build apps that make, open, download or serve packs.
